checks: Ctrl-wheel over a reaction badge changes only the drawing camera and cancels browser zoom.
Meta-wheel and unmodified trackpad panning over DOM content both reach the drawing camera.
Hand drag can begin on a reaction and continues across DOM layers without toggling a vote.
Unknown future DOM/SVG content inherits zoom and hand panning from the surface.
A drag beginning on the drawing continues through and beyond a DOM layer; hit testing is restored on release.
Space-drag and middle-button navigation also work when starting on DOM content.
Document-local scrolling is preserved, while modified wheel zoom still targets the board.
Zoom shortcuts on an embedded editor affect the board, while ordinary text input and spaces remain editable.
WebKit gesture streams are cancelled at the non-passive surface; browser viewport and device scale stay unchanged.
A normal selection-mode click still toggles the reaction.
Help retains keyboard shortcuts and removes the upstream documentation/blog/feedback/YouTube strip.
